description: This file defines a class 'ProjectMenuConfigurator' responsible for configuring menu items for the 'Project' section within the 'Time' plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and uses traits for module screen handling, overriding the screen 'viewProjects' in its configuration.

classes.name: ProjectMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings for the 'Projects' section in the 'Time' module by overriding the screen to 'viewProjects'. Implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and uses traits for helper functions.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewProjects' for the module, implementing the 'MenuConfigurator' interface's method.
